summary: ACH payment returned (R03) — manual reversal and reissue required after supplier bank change
description: Issue summary: An outbound ACH batch to supplier 'OptiCore LLC' (vendor ID V-9921) returned with ACH return code R03 (No Account/Unable to Locate Account). The original payment was processed on 2026-02-28 for invoice INV-2026-0047 amount $42,760.00. Impact: Payment is showing as returned in the payment provider portal and the supplier is reporting non-receipt. GL shows payment as pending cleared; AP auto-apply did not mark invoice as paid. Business impact: Vendor is withholding next delivery (SLA risk). Treasury requires reversal entry and proof of return before reissuing to avoid duplicate payment. Background: Vendor recently submitted a bank update via vendor-portal on 2026-02-25; VendorOps confirmed account change but there was no micro-deposit verification completed prior to scheduling batch. Payment details: Provider: ClearWirePay; Batch ID: CW-ACH-20260228-71; Origination date: 2026-02-28; Return code: R03; Provider error note: "No account on file / unable to locate account number". Steps to reproduce / events: 1) 2026-02-25: VendorOps updated bank account for V-9921 in vendor master (change request attached). 2) 2026-02-28: AP scheduled and released ACH batch including INV-2026-0047. 3) 2026-03-01: ClearWirePay return notice received; payment posted as 'returned' in payments dashboard. 4) Vendor contacted finance via email claiming funds not received. Logs / evidence: - ClearWirePay return PDF (attached) - Payment provider status: RETURNED R03 - VendorOps change order: vendor-bank-change-2026-02-25.pdf - AP ledger entry screenshots (timestamped) Related artifacts: attachments listed below. Recommended immediate actions: hold write-off, perform manual reversal in ledger, confirm vendor account via signed confirmation + micro-deposit before reissue, reissue via wire for faster settlement pending verification. Follow-up controls: require micro-deposit verification or two-person approval on bank changes for vendors exceeding $10k per payment, add ACH-return handling automation to AP runbook.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: vendor provided incorrect account number or change was partial (routing/account swapped). Treasury verification performed against the vendor-supplied bank details and ClearWirePay trace; trace shows beneficiary account not found. VendorOps confirmed they received a scanned voided check that appears different from bank details entered by the vendor on 2026-02-25 (possible data-entry error). No evidence of duplicate payment being received by the vendor. AP confirmed the invoice remained open after return. Cross-checked vendor master history in the vendor-portal audit log: bank change event created by user 'jordan.v' on 2026-02-25 14:03 UTC; no micro-deposit completed. Payment provider logs indicate ACH return code R03; ClearWirePay support confirmed returns are final and funds were debited back to our operating account on 2026-03-01 04:12 UTC.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Liam O'Connor: Flagged as P1. Treasury confirmed R03 return and requested reversal guidance. Holding any offline full refund until vendor confirms correct account. Assigned to Liam for coordination with VendorOps and Treasury.

2026-03-02 - Priya Rao (VendorOps): Vendor called and says they updated bank on 2026-02-24 with their AP contact. They emailed a scanned voided check; it does not match the account number entered by our portal (possible transposition). Asked vendor to complete bank-change confirmation form and to expect micro-deposit within 48 hours if new account is verified.

2026-03-03 - Tara Singh (Treasury): Confirmed return funds credited back to operating account. We will reverse the original payment ledger entry and record a return clearing entry. Recommend reissue via wire once vendor provides bank confirmation; wire to be approved by Finance Director before release.

2026-03-04 - Liam O'Connor: Performed manual reversal in the ledger per Treasury instructions (journal ID JR-2026-03-04-88). AP marked invoice INV-2026-0047 as 'awaiting-reissue'. Vendor provided signed bank confirmation form at 2026-03-04 09:12 UTC; micro-deposit verification pending (sent 2026-03-04 10:00 UTC). Preparing wire approval package.

2026-03-05 - Maya Chen: Wire executed to vendor (Trace WIRE-20260305-17) after Finance Director approval. Confirmed vendor received funds 2026-03-05 18:45 UTC. Closing ticket; follow-up: update vendor onboarding process and add automation to AP runbook for ACH returns mapping.
resolution_notes: Completed manual reversal of the returned ACH in the general ledger (JR-2026-03-04-88). Awaiting-reissue status set for INV-2026-0047. Vendor provided bank confirmation form and micro-deposit verified; wire approved and executed (WIRE-20260305-17). Treasury confirmed funds delivered and AP applied payment to invoice. VendorOps updated vendor master and enabled 'requires-micro-deposit' flag for V-9921. Control changes: 1) New rule enforced for vendor bank changes: require micro-deposit or two-person approval for vendors with payments > $10k. 2) AP runbook updated with ACH-return codes mapping and automated reversal checklist (Confluence page linked). Recommended follow-up ticket to implement vendor-master validation step in vendor-portal (automation to block bank changes without micro-deposit); see linked follow-up INT-54012. Financial impact: No duplicate payment; short delay in vendor payment; no write-offs. Ticket resolved after wire confirmation and ledger reconciliation.
